performed_steps.detail: Verified the task-manifest envelope with the project CLI and confirmed its canonical hash.
Generated a fresh isolated Ed25519 did:key labeled worker.
Created one signed request for the specified room, decimal nonce, task ID, and manifest hash, then validated its signature locally.
Made one live signed write attempt; the service returned HTTP 200 and the response body hash recorded in evidence.
Read the same room once with format=json; the service returned HTTP 200 and a record matching the DID, nonce, and swept text.
Observed that the returned record fields were seq, ts, from, text, and nonce, with no signature field.
Inspected line-stable official source locations at the manifest-pinned commit and recorded those references in worker evidence.
